balls.text: finishes the innings off on a high, walks across the stumps, and lofts the length ball over midwicket
Dogra sacrifices his wicket to keep Voges on strike, hit down to long-on, but they come back for two, and Piyush keeps his head again, throwing it right over the stumps to Irfan
slower ball, hits it to wide of sweeper-cover, comes back for two
lovely shot! wide yorker, and he reaches out for it and squeezes it past point, once again superb placement
slower ball, opens the face, and gets Voges on strike

goes for a non-existent double after hitting it straight to long-off, Piyush goes for the right end, the striker's, and also hits the stumps direct. Would have been run out even if this was not a direct-hit
looks to force a back-of-a-length delivery into the off side, gets a single off the bottom edge
good ball, good shot, full and wide outside off, he gets his bat down in time, and slices it fine of square third man
backs away too soon, Theron bowls it short and wide enough of him, good comeback by the bowler after that early boundary
and again he has missed a scoop shot, he is good down the ground, but he has missed at least three of those cute shots
length ball, 107ks, asking to be hit, and he gets on a knee, and smacks it wide of long-off
yorker, on the pads, bunted for one
slower ball, and thwacked back past the bowler, the mid-off is up, and there is no stopping this
full on the pads, clears his front leg, and misses on the swipe, the ball goes between his legs
superb running and placement, first of all he has placed it wide of sweeper-cover, and a slight fumble from Yuvraj lets them come back for three
makes room, Irfan puts in the slower delivery, gets a bottom edge for one
nice shot, stays deep in the crease and drives a full delivery past extra cover
full and wide outside off, doesn't make good connection, gets a single to sweeper-cover
angled into the pads, sharp delivery, beaten for pace, gets a leg-bye, end of a good over for Punjab
short, cut away to sweeper-cover
looks to manufacture the scoop over short fine, and he bowls full and slow, and Faiz misses - no runs off the bat so far in this over
sees him back away, angles it across him, and it's far enough of the batsman, but not far enough to be called wide
appeals for a ball sliding down the leg side, and Voges has also walked down the pitch, doesn't persist with the appeal thankfully
length ball, and Voges swings inside the line, misses a straight delivery
slower ball, dabbed to third man for one
walks down the track, gets under a length ball, and lofts it with just enough power so as to clear long-on
swiped across the line, gets a single to deep square leg
slightly late into a swat across the line, gets a single to long-on
good placement again, comes on the front foot, drives it wide of long-off, comes back for two
starts off with a slower one, hit straight to point
late-cuts this one, for a change finds the short third man fielder
and he teases them some more, bunted into the leg side, and he comes back for two because he has not hit it powerfully
he knows this ground like his house? another superbly placed shot, that semi-slog-sweep again, and again finds the gap between long-on and midwicket, all along the ground
comes down the track, hits straight to extra cover
good placement again, he is exposing it like Swiss cheese, short delivery, just a mere dab, but wide of long-on
Fazal comes down the track, throws everything at it, the ball doesn't turn and gets a thick edge for a single to short third
another nice shot from Voges, not frills, no big back lift, just a drive wide enough of long-off
short, pulled away to deep midwicket
onto the pads, worked away for one

This one is for Kingfisher Fair Play! Hit powerfully back at him and Yuvraj takes his hands out of the way and the ball hits the stumps, but Punjab appeal for a run-out. Replays reveal everything, brothers. It was just an instinctive appeal I feel, not intentional foul play. Will give him benefit of doubt. There is no way there was a touch on it, though
into the pads, and worked away for one to midwicket
starts with a semi-slog-sweep, and it is effective, doesn't quite get on a knee but gets really low, and swats it wide of long-on, into the cow corner
slower ball does Yusuf in! Hasn't yet hit a clean Yusuf shot, and gives this one everything, and is early into the shot, and skies it down the ground, Yuvraj takes a safe catch running in
length ball, and he gets under it, and hits it powerfully and straight and high, it takes ages to come down but clears Yuvraj at long-on
oh sorry, spoke too soon, Shalabh belts out a huge shout from the deepest part of his gut, as he has missed a scoop shot way way outside off
way wide outside off, surprisingly no appeal from Sanga this time
looks for the pull but it is onto him too fast, and it goes towards mid-off
good attempt by Yuvraj at mid-on, hit powerfully and dying on him, Yuvraj also had to move to his right, and while he lunged forward he at least got a hand to it as it bounced in front of him
short, not much width, but Yusuf goes after it regardless, gets it over the infield and takes a couple despite not the cleanest of hits
looks to paddle it fine but ends up hitting it one bounce to short fine leg
quick delivery again, and he is contend with a single to cover
drives a googly with an open face, gets a single to sweeper-cover
flat, into the pads, bunted away for one
reads a googly and biffs it to cow corner and comes back for two before midwicket can come around
square-drive, good-looking shot, gets one to sweeper-cover
runs this one down to third man for a single
whipped away from in front of stumps, doesn't make good contact, gets a single
pushed to sweeper-cover for one
short and he misses out, makes good contact on the pull, but can't get it past midwicket
short, into the body, tucked away for a single
big wide down the leg side
into the pads, worked away square of fine leg
nice shot, clean clean swing, comes down the track again, gets to its pitch, and lofts him over midwicket
pushed down to long-off for a single
comes down the track and hits him to wide of long-off, where Kaif keeps them down to one
pushed towards sweeper-cover for one
bunted wide of point for a single
steps down the track, is beaten in the flight, but recovers well to defend it
short ball again, this time he is beaten on the pull
Irfan has dropped brother Yusuf! slower ball, Yusuf throws everything at it, ends up skying it, Irfan runs to his right from long-off, gets under it, but the hands don't come together in time
huge huge shout for a catch down the leg side, and the umpire calls it a wide because there is light between glove and ball
tires the bouncer, gets it into his ribs, at , and he wallops it to the square-leg fence, need to be quicker than that
walks across the stumps, exposing all three sticks, slower ball comes out, drops into the leg side and runs, Yusuf wants two but is rightly sent back
very nice shot, exploits the square third man, opens the face very late and gets four
short, into the hips, pulled away, not very convincingly, gets a single
short, and wide down the leg side
gets the big front foot down, bunts it into the covers for a single
flat outside off, played to point, no turn
flicked away from around off, wide of long-on, but Bopara is quick enough to keep them down to one
gets the big front down the pitch, turns it around the corner, comes through for one

Sanga may not be good at appealing, but he has pulled of a winner of a stumping here. Good bowling by Piyush too. He saw Lumb is not picking the spin, and he floats a googly outside off, drawing him into the shot, then beating him, and Sanga pounces on the slightest bit of overbalancing and whips the bails off during the two seconds that his foot is in the air
goes for the slog sweep and is beaten first ball, no spin, and another big shout, Sanga keeps shouting for long, but it has hit him outside off, and is not spinning in either
length ball, hit through covers, gets a single to sweeper-cover
slower ball, too full, he hits it straight and powerfully, Theron fields well in the followthrough
too much width too often, and this time he crashes it past point, and fine of third man, top shot
nice offcutter, starts off, and nips away, beating the shot
short and wide, and he misses out on that, just couldn't make any connection with the shot
hit away first ball, length ball, nicely driven through the covers for two
stayed back to a full delivery, for a milisecond, Sree must have thought of an lbw, but he got his bat down in time
looks to run this down to third man, but it's not wide enough, gets an inside edge onto the pad, another amusing appeal from Punjab
big wide down the leg side
he is adamant on the pull shot, this more of a swat, to a length delivery, gets a single to square leg
pulled away, again too full for the shot, and hence he hits it straight to straight midwicket
nicely chopped away to third man
premeditates a pull, Sree is too full for the shot, and he just manages a single off the bottom edge to fine leg
slower ball, 92ks, delays his shot, plays with soft hands, gets a single to third man
pulled away, into the gap on the leg side, gets a couple
short, wide and he duly punishes it, powerfully cut and nicely placed wide of point
pick-up shot, nicely done, takes it from off, makes sweet connection, and there is no intention of keeping it down
steps down the track, and wafts and misses
looks to square-cut, gets the bottom part of the bat, gets a single
wafts outside off, and he plays way outside the line of the delivery
gets out of the jail with another short-pitched delivery, into his ribs, and the second free-hits gets RR only a single - two free-hits for just one run so far
second no-ball for Sree, and again the actual delivery is a gem, cutting him in two with the inswing, but he has overstepped
soft dismissal, against the run of play, hits a length delivery straight down the lap of mid-on, and Sree gives him a nice little send-off
on the pads, and worked away for an easy single
well played, effective shot, gives him the charge, and gets under a shortish delivery to loft it over point, gets enough on it to beat the in-ring
on target, fullish, swinging in to Lumb, defended back to the bowler
back of a length, wide of off, and chopped away to square third man
whipped away off the pads, wide of fine leg, gets a couple, and this is Rajasthan's best opening stand this season
angling across him, and steered away to third man
nice pick-up shot, leg-stump line, and he just flicks it over midwicket, all power comes in that last instance, through the wrists
overthrow, sloppy work by Theron at mid-on, looks to drop to cover and run, is sent back, but Bopara goes for a throw, and Theron at mid-on doesn't bend quick enough to get his body behind it
full outside off, slight swing, he throws everything at it, gets a thick edge that clears backward point, and also beats a diving Bisla at third man
back of a length, into the pads, defended
shot of the night so far, just meets a length ball outside off with an open face, and the ball speeds across, past cover-point, third man, who is very square, has no chance
comes back well, beats him with a full, away-swinging delivery, and Sangakkara belts out a big annoying appeal, even after umpire has said no he keeps on shouting
Oh Sree, couldn't bowl four good deliveries in a row, goes short and wide, and is cut away, and Sangakkara has removed the second slip, which came in just one ball ago
that's three in three, what a ripper of a legcutter, pitches back of a length, just outside off, and moves ever so slightly away, squaring him up
comes back well, with a bouncer, 138ks, beats him again. You have done well if you manage to beat a batsman on a free hit, and not by bowling a wide
good start - spoke too soon. He is actually too good with the ball straightening outside off and beating Ojha, but he has also over-stepped. Why am I not surprised?
slower ball, checks his drive, it gets a thick edge, and sails past first slip, and fine of a square third man
square-drive, more like throwing his arms at a wide delivery, finds cover-point
walks across the stumps, goes against the swing, and manages to clear mid-on
fumble by Yuvraj at mid-off, doesn't cost them a run, first time bat met ball tonight
slashes at one outside away, is beaten by the swing, will be interesting to see how long the swing lasts
back of a length, swinging away from Lumb, left alone
Tait ends it with a full and straight delivery, middle and leg stump gone, superb finish for Rajasthan after they were getting blown away at one time during the defence
Sreesanth is done with the shot by the time the slower ball arrives
gone! no options really than to go after everything, and he goes straight down the ground, but gets too much under it and skies it to long-on
and another free hit goes unpunished, good bouncer, no room there, all Mahela needed was a tickle because third man was in the circle but it kept following him
dropped off a no-ball at deep midwicket! Dogra had three or four gos at it, but doesn't really matter
slower ball, drags it from outside off to wide of long-on for two
low full toss on the pads, yorker gone wrong, and he plays the pick-up shot over fine leg, superb timing
and Mahela is comprehensively beaten by a slower one, way too early into the swipe
jumps out of the crease, and is far away from this bouncer when he swings his bat
backs away, and Tait goes full and wide again, Mahela can't get any power into this one, will be just a single
and another one bites the dust! bouncer, sharp one, and Theron gets the toe-end of the bat, lobbing it to mid-off
full and wide, Mahela - who has backed away - manages only a thick edge on it, and gets a single
short, outside off, Jayawardene looks to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce
yorker on middle and leg, Theron gets his bat down in time
heaved away into the on side for one
quick quick delivery, 97ks, hits him outside off, hence not given lbw
swept away again, powerfully but straight to fine leg
Chawla comes down the track, looking to hit it over midwicket, slices it to short third where Tait takes the catch
swept away in the air, one bounce to fine leg
gets a top-edge on the sweep, but it lands in front of fine leg
comes down the track, too close to the pitch of the ball, and hits it along the ground to long-on
slider, and he late-cuts it past short third man, smart shot, but Tait's dive not top notch
cuts from close of off stump, not much room, but squeezes a single to backward point
Tarapore has let another batsman off, pitched slightly outside off, turning in, and Chawla has missed it, and it has hit him in line of off
reverse-sweep and he connects but finds short third man
turned away from in front of stumps to the on side for one

Kaif is given this time! sweeping across the line, misses, Yusuf is straight enough, and Umpire Doctrove upholds the appeal despite the stride, which was the only thing that could have saved him. Hawk-eye says middle stump would have been hit
slows it down a bit this time, shorter too, gets a single to midwicket
fired into the pads again, 96ks, swept away to fine leg for one
fired into the pads, helped away for one
pitched up on the pads, turned away to midwicket for one
short, on the stumps, pulled away to deep midwicket
lovely shot from Kaif, pitched up to him, and he chips it over extra cover, nice placement
swept away from in front of stumps, gets a single to fine leg
pushed down the ground for a single
punched off the back foot, straight to cover-point

and Umpire Tarapore has let him off. Kaif was a sitting duck there. Played across the line of a full delivery that pitched within the stumps, straightened, caught his pad in front of stumps, and would have hit off stump

what an incredible slower ball and what incredible work from Jhunjhunwala running in from cover! Jayawardene is taken by surprise big time, and it grips at him, lobs just over Munaf who can't back-pedal fast enough but Jhunjhunwala charges from cover and under-arm-flicks and finds a backing-up Irfan short. Top work
on the pads, worked away easily
drives away from the body, gets a thick edge for one

Munna strikes! another slower ball gets them a wicket! Two settled batsmen play loose shots. Walks down the wicket, Munaf bowls a slower one that grips at him, and despite a checked shot it flies to the right of mid-on where Sid T takes a nice catch. Bopara is livid. And for a change, no send-off from a bowler, despite their earlier spat in the initial overs
strays onto the pads, worked away for one
and starts with a lovely legcutter, back of a length, outside off, Jayawardene drives, and is beaten by the straightening of the line
punches a fullish delivery, straight to Munaf at - drum roll - cover-point
flat, into the pads, worked around the corner
slightly fuller and straighter, pushed down to long-on for one
read 11.2 for this ball's description
short and wide again, cut away again, single again
wide and short, cut away for a single
Yuvraj has eased Lumb's pain here, doesn't read a slower ball, and skies it towards long-on, and Faiz takes this overhead catch easily, running back from mid-on
pushed down to long-on for one

Has Lumb dropped the match? This was a sharp bouncer and Yuvraj ends up hitting straight down Lumb's chest at deep square. And that's what exactly where it hits him, in the chest. Didn't get his hands up in time
good late-cut, deliberately to beat point, Dogra from third man makes a nice diving save, saves RR two runs
short ball, Yuvraj wants to send it to the midwicket stand, but pulls over it - not sure it stayed low
slower ball, yorker-length too, gets a single to long-on
lbw appeal as Bopara misses a sweep shot but it is pitched outside leg
he has missed a lollypop full toss, gets a bottom edge onto the pads while thinking which part of the crowd to hit it to
pushed down to long-off for one
winding up to hit this one too, but it dips on him, and turns into him, and he changes the shot well to take a single to midwicket
lovely clean strike, flighted, almost a half-volley, and Yuvraj sends its crashing into the sight screen
slower ball again, hit to sweeper-cover for one
way wide outside off
slower ball, hit straight to cover-point, dot
short, wide, cut away fine, to third man
slower ball, nearly yorker length, beats Yuvraj
that's a snorter! Short, sharp, rising, and Yuvraj has to get his hands out of the way pretty fast
walks across the stumps and flicks a shortish delivery to fine leg
crunchy inside-out drive first ball, past extra cover

smart dismissal, Warne has a fielder placed for the slog! Legspinner bowling with a deep midwicket! He tosses it up outside off, and Bisla slog-sweeps, and Lumb doesn't have to move an inch. Nonetheless that cameo will hurt Rajasthan
Bisla is putting up a show against Warne, gives him the charge again, Warne floats it wide of off, but he recovers and chips it over extra cover
swept away from leg stump to deep square leg
Bisla is shaping to come forward, sees a short ball, stays back and milks a single to the leg side
slower ball, around off, looks to turn his wrist on it, ends up hitting it back to the bowler
back of a length, pushed down to long-on
slower ball, and again tip-and-run
dropped on the pitch and comes through for one, Trivedi does well and is swift and would have got him had he hit the non-striker's stumps direct
dances down the track, mis-hits a short delivery, but keeps it down
offcutter, no room, accurate, defended
shorter, turning across him, and pushed down to long-off

straighter this time, beautifully hit, steps out and gets to the pitch and hits him into the sightscreen, hitting a cameraman on the way - going by his praise for Ysuuf's innings, Warne could say this is the worst punishment he has been given
Bislaaaa, no respect for reputation here, is semi-beaten in flight, but he opens up and goes square over the on side, one bounce for four
nearly bowled him around his legs, and called wide
Bisla premeditates a sweep, is beaten duly, but Warne appeals despite its pitching outside leg
gets some dip on it, but he keeps it shorter, and he has turned it around the corner
flighted nicely, but a bit too far down the pads and too full, and he has swept him fine, fine of short fine
steps out and lofts him over wide mid-on, good clear-minded batting, he knows there are vast open spaces out there and doesn't mind a mis-hit as long as he is hitting into those vacant spaces
is cramped up by Munaf, but gets enough power in that punch shot to clear extra cover
short ball, following him, he lets it go, I heard a click as it passed but I must be hearing things because the bowler has not even asked a polite question
makes room and is early into a slower ball, but he has gone for the straight shot and even though it is skied it has enough muscle behind it to go for a six

one ball and he has got his eye in, similar delivery, but comes forward and lofts his over midwicket, not much pace to bother him. Jeremy Coney calls it a rustic shot on air. I don't disagree vehemently
hits the Munaf length, back of a length, outside off, defended to cover

Tait gets his own back! Short again, higher this time, and Sanga makes room and goes for the upper-cut, but doesn't put too much power into it, and hits it straight down third man's throat. No room was the critical factor there
and now he gets lucky, Tait tucks him up with a swift short delivery, and the bottom edge goes for four
short this time and cut away elegantly, Voges dives full length at cover-point to get a hand on it
and again, not classical this time, clears the front leg, but times it through covers again
that's the Sanga we know, super- square-drive, the ball went away through covers as fast as it came on, superbly timed, and high elbow was the bonus
short ball, around off, gets on top of it, and bunts and runs
nicely driven, slower ball and squeezes it through covers, Lumb puts in a spirited chase and makes a diving save
worked away off the pads to midwicket for a single
bottom edge for four, swipes across the line, and the edge travels fast and also misses the stumps
slapped away in the air towards mid-off who thinks he is in the game, but it goes wide of the fielder, and travels fast
effective shot, walks down the pitch and pulls him over the in-ring on the leg side, and gets three runs
looks for a black-and-run but he has hit it too strongly to midwicket
looks for that Dale Steyn delivery, swinging from leg to take out off, but this is too full and hence he plays it close to his body and gets a single to mid-off
swing again, and beats him outside off

Ojha is all at sea, good swing bowling here, and the keeper who has no confidence in his bowler seemingly, is already moving down the leg side, but the ball has beautifully shaped away from just outside off, and squared Bopara up, but Ojha puts in the dive to his right to collect it
good-looking off-drive, just a single to mid-off
wafts and misses outside off
wide yorker, a rather harsh call I would say, as it hit the line, cut the bowlers some slack somewhere
Ojha had dropped it down the leg side, loud woody nice as he looks to glance this one slides down the leg side, and it's not too far from him, but he is purely beaten for pace
charges down at him, plays across the line of a length delivery, and hits uppishly, but just wide enough of mid-on
slightly fuller, driven on the up, beautiful shot, straight to mid-off
stays at that same length, slightly slower, 127ks, plays it with an open face for a single
just back of driving length, outside off, defended towards cover
shimmies down the track, drops it into the covers and takes a single
just back of a length, nipping in, helped away to fine leg for one
